title: Java and Spring Boot
description: Conventions for Java and Spring Boot.

rules.title: Constructor injection
rules.text: Use constructor injection; avoid field injection.

rules.title: Records and immutability
rules.text: Use records and immutable types for DTOs.

rules.title: Controller, service, repository
rules.text: Keep controllers thin, logic in services and persistence in repositories.

rules.title: Bean validation
rules.text: Validate request bodies with Jakarta Bean Validation annotations.

rules.title: Optional for return values
rules.text: Use Optional only for return values, never for fields or parameters.
